tools.name: list_pet_poison_countries
tools.description: List the countries for which a veterinary poison service has been recorded, and which of them have a poison centre that refuses animal calls. Use this to check coverage before calling find_pet_poison_service.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "list_pet_poison_countries" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: List the countries for which a veterinary poison service has been recorded, and which of them have a poison centre that refuses animal calls. Use this to check …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
